knowledge_graph.title: Pearl City High School
knowledge_graph.description: Pearl City High School is a public, co-ed comprehensive high school located in Pearl City, Hawaii which serves grades 9–12. Its mascot is the Charger and is operated by the Hawaii State Department of Education in the Leeward Complex.
